description.zh: 本次请求可返回的媒体Bucket数目最大值。取值范围：1~100，默认值：50。
description.en: The maximum number of media buckets to return. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 50.

description.zh: 下一页标识。第一次请求无需传入，服务会返回此Token，第二次请求传入即可。
description.en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. The response to the first request contains this parameter, which is added to the next request.

descriptions.zh:
本接口最多返回100个媒体Bucket。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~342832~~)。
descriptions.en:
A maximum of 100 media buckets can be returned.

### QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 10 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you will experience service interruptions. We recommend that you take note of this limit when you call this operation. For more information, see [QPS limit](~~342832~~).
